page.t: Balanced Mode (spread purchases evenly instead of top-to-bottom priority)
Fill Cargo Before Returning (buy every wanted ware first, deliver all at once; off = classic immediate buy-then-deliver per ware)
Also Resupply Build Storage (buy construction wares for stations under construction or being expanded)
Service Build Storage First (before production wares, when both need supplies this pass)
Price Cap Mode: on = % below home sell price, off = absolute max price
Absolute Max Price per Unit (used when Price Cap Mode is off)
Min Discount % Below Home Sell Price - skip deals not at least this much cheaper (used when Price Cap Mode is on)
Scan Performance (higher = smoother but slower reactions)
Enable Debug Log (writes troubleshooting details to a log file)

Restocks the assigned home station(s) by buying their wanted wares from the cheapest accessible seller within range.
